description: Implement psionic/lib/inkling-responses.coax reasoning/tool-call parser and SSE formatter with runnable example.

steps.send: Implement the Inkling 2 Mini reasoning/tool-call parser and SSE formatter (#13824): create `psionic/lib/inkling-responses.coax` with `#test` checks for parsing `<think>...</think>` reasoning blocks, `<tool_call>...</tool_call>` blocks, and formatting OpenAI-compatible SSE response chunks, plus a runnable example `psionic/examples/inkling-responses.coax`. Verify with `coax/bin/coax test psionic/lib/inkling-responses.coax`.
